description: Reduce depth to 6 and widen to model_dim 640 (ASPECT_RATIO 106, 5 heads) so the smaller model sees more tokens in 300s.
Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 so grad accumulation drops from 8 to 4 and the model gets more optimizer steps in the 300s budget.
Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.05 so the LR warmdown ends at 5% of the initial LR instead of decaying to zero.
No change: attention c_proj and MLP c_proj are already zero-initialised in init_weights, so the idea is already implemented.
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.3 so more training time is spent at peak LR before the linear decay to zero.
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the final 70% of the time budget.
Abort: EMA is not worth a slot.

issues: Nothing here calls for a veto. The diff only changes the logit softcap in the model's forward pass from 15 to 10. It doesn't touch the val_bpb metric, the data, the seed lines or the evaluation call. The softcap also applies at evaluation time, but that's just part of the model, which is allowed.
No bugs found that would make the result meaningless. A softcap of 10 is a valid hyperparameter: it limits the logits to ±10 through tanh.

The numbers don't support a gain. The candidate's single run scored 1.1144 against the incumbent's mean of 1.1145 over 16 runs. The 0.0001 difference is well within noise (z = 0.012), so the provisional reject matches the evidence.
I couldn't recompute z. The harness didn't give the incumbent's standard deviation or its per-run values. Working backwards, the reported z implies a noise scale of about 0.008, which I can't check.

description: Lower the logit softcap from 15 to 10 in GPT.forward.
Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4 to test a gentler Adam learning rate on token embeddings.
No change: the idea is already in train.py.
Change WINDOW_PATTERN from "SSSL" to "SL" so half the layers use full attention (final layer stays full).
Lower Muon cautious weight decay from 0.2 to 0.1 (the schedule in get_weight_decay scales from this constant).
Clip the global gradient norm to 1.0 after the accumulated backward passes and before optimizer.step(); no clipping exists in the file today.
Set HEAD_DIM to 64 so the 512-wide model uses 8 heads instead of 4.
Keep a 0.999 EMA of parameters (started after 10% of the time budget, updated with torch._foreach_lerp_) and copy it into the model just before the final evaluation.

issues: Not a problem: the diff changes one line in attention. It multiplies the RMS-normed q and k by 1.2, which raises attention logits by about 1.44x. This is an ordinary architecture change. It does not touch the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines, the prepare.py import or the evaluation call.
No bug that would make the result meaningless. The scale is applied after rotary embedding and normalization and before flash attention, so it works the same in training and evaluation.

The candidate has only one run (1.1126) against an incumbent mean of 1.1145 over 16 runs, a difference of about 0.0019. The reported z is 0.335, which is small. One run cannot separate this from seed noise, so the provisional reject is consistent with the numbers.

z cannot be recomputed exactly because the incumbent's standard deviation, or the formula the harness uses, is not given. If z = diff/sd, the implied sd is about 0.0057. That is plausible but cannot be checked.
The fixed 1.2 constant is a hand-tuned magic number. A learnable QK scale or temperature would be a cleaner version if this idea is followed up.

description: Multiply q and k by a fixed 1.2 after QK rms-norm, which scales attention logits by 1.44 to sharpen attention.
Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**17 (grad accumulation 2) and scale MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.034.
Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.03 and WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.4; the existing get_lr_multiplier already computes warmup as progress / WARMUP_RATIO.
Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 to test a higher Muon learning rate.
Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.02 so the LR ramps linearly from 0 to peak over the first 2% of the time budget.
No change: HEAD_DIM 64 was already run in slot 10 and was worse (+0.0006).
Deepen the model to 10 layers at width 512 (ASPECT_RATIO 51 rounds up to 512) and halve the batch to 2**18 so it gets more optimizer steps.
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.3, FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.05 and add global grad-norm clipping to 1.0 before optimizer.step().
